about: Sentences from an attempt to break src/server/rules.ts with several hundred inputs (15 November 2026). 'caught' must each lose the sentence that carries the address, email or number. 'kept' are ordinary sentences an earlier version damaged, and must come back exactly as written. 'dropped_on_purpose' look like real addresses, emails or numbers to a reader, so they are dropped even though a product might mean them innocently. 'known_through' still get past: each is a spelling no reader is likely to follow. Characters that draw nothing are in here as themselves, so view this file with care.
